_instructions: Add a team member by copying a block. Put the headshot in /assets/team/. If an image is missing it falls back to a plain navy tile instead of a broken icon. Add bio, linkedin, and expertise fields for richer profiles.

team.name: Rollins Chitika
team.bio: Rollins founded Equip Group in 2019 with a vision to bridge the gap between ambitious Malawian entrepreneurs and the structured support they need to scale. He brings 15+ years of experience in business development, investment facilitation, and SME ecosystem building across Southern Africa. Previously led enterprise development programs for international development agencies.

team.name: Matilda Nhlane
team.bio: Matilda leads Equip's operational excellence, ensuring project teams deliver on time, on budget, and to standard. She has 10+ years managing multi-disciplinary teams in consulting and development sectors. Certified PMP with a focus on adaptive project management in resource-constrained environments.

team.name: Tereza Chaponda
team.bio: Tereza heads the Business Development practice, overseeing incubator programs, investment readiness, and SME acceleration. She has designed and delivered entrepreneurship programs for UN Women, Standard Bank, and GIZ. Passionate about women's economic empowerment in agriculture.

team.name: Ipyana Mkandawire
team.bio: Ipyana specializes in monitoring & evaluation and adaptive learning for agriculture and food security programs. He has led baseline, mid-term, and end-line evaluations for AGRA, IFAD, and World Bank-funded projects. Skilled in KoBoToolbox, Power BI, and qualitative outcome harvesting.

team.name: Mervis Msukwa
team.bio: Mervis ensures seamless project execution through rigorous administrative and financial management. She manages budgets, contracts, compliance, and reporting for multi-donor programs. Her organizational precision keeps complex, multi-stakeholder projects running smoothly.

team.name: Sophie Chisa
team.bio: Sophie bridges project delivery and strategic communications. She manages stakeholder engagement, knowledge products, and digital outreach for Equip's research and business development portfolios. Background in development communications and social media strategy.

team.name: Lusungu Masawanie
team.bio: Lusungu transforms complex datasets into intuitive, actionable visual stories. She leads Equip's Data Division design practice — building dashboards, interactive portals, and print-ready infographics for government, donors, and private sector. Expert in Power BI, Tableau, and D3.js.

team.name: Lizzie Mwanandi
team.bio: Lizzie handles data engineering, statistical analysis, and survey design for Equip's research projects. She builds reproducible data pipelines, conducts econometric analysis, and produces evidence briefs for policy audiences. Proficient in R, Python, Stata, and SQL.

team.name: Pacharo Njoloma
team.bio: Pacharo supports Business Development projects with a focus on market systems and value chain analysis. He has worked on agricultural commercialization programs across Malawi and Zambia. Strong in field coordination, partner management, and results reporting.

team.name: Dorica Nyasulu
team.bio: Dorica manages Equip's financial operations — budgeting, forecasting, donor financial reporting, and audit compliance. She ensures all projects meet fiduciary standards of international donors (World Bank, EU, IFAD, bilateral agencies). ACCA affiliate.

team.name: Jacqueline Chibambo
team.bio: Jacqueline works on Research & Project Management engagements, specializing in qualitative research, policy analysis, and stakeholder consultations. She has contributed to national strategy documents for the Ministry of Agriculture and Ministry of Youth. Strong writing and synthesis skills.

team.name: Maxwell Mkumba
team.bio: Maxwell drives Equip's digital presence — website, social media, email marketing, and content strategy. He also supports clients with digital transformation and online market access. Background in e-commerce and growth marketing for African SMEs.

team.name: Danford Mponda
team.bio: Danford architects Equip's data infrastructure — pipelines, warehouses, APIs, and real-time dashboards. He built the MSE Tracker live feed, the agro-processing portal, and automated reporting systems for multiple clients. Expert in Python, SQL, Airflow, and cloud data platforms.

team.name: Haywood Liuma
team.bio: Haywood creates Equip's visual identity across all touchpoints — brand, reports, dashboards, presentations, and digital assets. He translates complex data and narratives into compelling visual communication. Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and motion graphics.

team.name: Blessings Akimu
team.bio: Blessings manages Equip's projects from conception to completion — ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and stakeholder satisfaction. She coordinates cross-functional teams and maintains project documentation. Background in project management for development initiatives in Africa.
